summary: Implemented and root-accepted the dependency-free, read-only portable integrity verifier. The final artifact makes the unchanged V4-T1 oracle GREEN on local Python 3.10 and 3.11, preserves v0.2/v0.3 compatibility and bytes, rejects intermediate Windows junctions without following them, and enforces case-sensitive serialized paths independently of the host filesystem.

claims.claim: The final verifier is the only V4-T2 production artifact and has a fixed reviewed identity.
evidence: Path: fixtures/adaptive-task-orchestrator-write-dag/tools/verify_integrity.py.
Before V4-T2 the path was absent.
Final size: 15113 bytes; final line count: 490.
The accepted test oracle remains SHA-256 1FFBD6FA3C264D48385262F385AA2C447E2A2C93C57602734D29B50EA1A89E98.

claims.claim: The unchanged targeted oracle and complete fixture suite are GREEN on both locally available supported Python runtimes.
evidence: Python 3.10 targeted: 14 tests passed, 1 combined real-symlink method skipped for WinError 1314, exit 0.
Python 3.11 targeted: 14 tests passed, the same method skipped, exit 0.
Python 3.10 full suite: 58 tests passed, 1 skip, exit 0.
Python 3.11 full suite: 58 tests passed, 1 skip, exit 0.
Python 3.10 and 3.11 AST parsing both passed.

claims.claim: The implementation is read-only, standard-library-only, deterministic, and fails closed at the approved parser, inventory, path, object, read, and digest boundaries.
evidence: Static inspection found no package-writing API, broad except Exception, dependency, subprocess, network, repair, or cache behavior.
Any manifest parser-semantic finding returns before target verification, preventing host-dependent cascaded findings.
Listed components are selected by exact child.name equality, inspected with lstat, rejected when reparse/nonconforming, contained, and only then opened for hashing.
Inventory checks Windows reparse attributes before directory descent.
Finding records are frozen and final results are sorted by code, path, and detail.

claims.claim: Windows-specific path hazards are rejected without changing the selected package or an out-of-package canary.
evidence: A real Windows junction listed as linked/target.txt returned MANIFEST_FILE_NOT_REGULAR for the listed path and MANIFEST_UNSUPPORTED_OBJECT for linked, exit 1.
The junction target canary SHA-256 was identical before and after verification, and the temporary probe was cleaned.
A real case.txt with manifest path Case.txt returned MANIFEST_FILE_MISSING for Case.txt and MANIFEST_UNLISTED_FILE for case.txt, exit 1.
The exact-case temporary probe was cleaned.

claims.claim: The immutable v0.2 and v0.3 packages retain their exact bytes and pass both integrity and structural validation on Python 3.10 and 3.11.
evidence: Four verify_integrity.py commands and four unchanged validate_evidence.py commands returned exit 0 with empty stdout.
v0.2 still declares 100 entries and manifest SHA-256 1B6B79AF7428AB0FF2D9F883858DBF4B78B4106880C3720D0E374397F7322A56.
v0.3 still declares 65 entries and manifest SHA-256 5B5831CFB6F597DC5D41E456D36B8C8CC4EB244E2E58D6EC25B00A84E11041A1.
git diff --name-only 52ec8c9 for both historical package paths is empty.

uncertainty: The local Windows host cannot create real os.symlink objects because of WinError 1314, so the accepted combined manifest/listed-file/directory symlink method remains skipped locally. The executed Windows junction probe covers the repaired reparse and intermediate-component behavior but is not POSIX symlink execution.
Linux Python 3.10 and 3.11 and the GitHub Actions Windows/Linux matrix have not yet executed the final artifact; they remain V4-T3/V4-T4 evidence rather than V4-T2 claims.

The first exact-case repair run exposed one case-collision regression by adding a host finding after a parser finding. The result is retained as repair evidence; the parser-semantic gate fixed it and all final targeted and full runs are GREEN.
The verifier assumes a quiescent package and is not a concurrent-adversary sandbox or an authenticity mechanism.
resources_accessed: Automatically cleaned unittest and bounded Windows probe temporary directories

checks.check: Final verifier SHA-256, size, line count, and accepted test-oracle identity.
Final v0.2/v0.3 integrity and structural compatibility on Python 3.10 and 3.11.
Historical v0.2/v0.3 diff from 52ec8c9 and static no-write/no-network/no-dependency inspection.

contradictions: The initial interrupted artifact passed the accepted oracle but could hash through an intermediate directory symlink; root and worker independently found the gap. The final per-component no-follow implementation and executed Windows junction probe resolve it.
The first exact-case patch produced a legitimate targeted regression; the final parser-semantic gate resolves it, and the failed intermediate run is preserved rather than hidden.
All local executable checks are GREEN, while Linux, GitHub Actions, and real os.symlink execution remain pending and are not claimed.

resolved_findings: intermediate directory symlink and Windows junction traversal
residual_caveats: GitHub Actions Windows/Linux matrix not yet executed
real local os.symlink method skipped for WinError 1314
